The '''flitterbat''' was a quick-moving creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. After [[Malefax]]'s [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] presence frightened fauna near the [[Dawn Temple]], flitterbats had to be enticed back to the temple to allow it to flourish again.
